onboarding.title: Welcome Guide
onboarding.description: Re-open the welcome guide to see an overview of WorkRecall's features.

developer.title: Developer
developer.description: Advanced settings for debugging and development.

prompts.title: Periodic Work Prompts
prompts.description: WorkRecall reminds you at regular intervals to log what you're working on. Set your preferred frequency — every 30 minutes is a great starting point.

autoCapture.title: Automatic Work Capture
autoCapture.description: Enable AI-powered automatic capture: WorkRecall takes periodic screenshots, analyzes them with AI, and creates work log entries — all without any manual input.

aiSummary.title: AI-Powered Summaries
aiSummary.description: Generate narrative summaries of your work day or week with a single click. Perfect for standups, performance reviews, and end-of-sprint retrospectives.

sprintBoard.title: Sprint Board
sprintBoard.description: Manage your tasks on a visual Kanban board. Link work log entries to tasks to automatically track how much time you spent on each.

export.title: Data Export
export.description: Export your work log entries as CSV or JSON. Use your data for career advocacy, freelance invoicing, or reporting.

title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your WorkRecall preferences and account settings.

promptFrequency.label: Prompt Frequency
promptFrequency.description: How often (in minutes) should WorkRecall prompt you to log your work?
promptFrequency.validationError: Please enter a value between 1 and 1440 minutes (24 hours)

launchOnStartup.title: Launch on Startup
launchOnStartup.description: Automatically start WorkRecall when you log in.

autoLogging.title: Automatic Work Logging
autoLogging.description: Automatically capture and analyze your work activity using AI.
autoLogging.screenshotsDescription: How many times per hour to capture screenshots (when screen changes). Higher values = more granular tracking, but more storage needed.
autoLogging.aiAnalysesDescription: How many times per day to run AI analysis on captured screenshots. Each analysis consumes one OpenAI API request and creates a work log entry.
autoLogging.screenshotsValidation: Screenshots per hour must be between 1 and 3600
autoLogging.apiRequestsValidation: API requests per day must be between 1 and 1440

howItWorksItems.screenshots: Screenshots taken at your configured rate (only when screen changes)
howItWorksItems.aiAnalysis: AI analyzes at your configured interval and creates work log entries
howItWorksItems.idle: Automatically pauses when computer is idle (5+ minutes)

featureTips.title: Feature tips
featureTips.description: Small hints that surface when you visit a page for the first time.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Store full API requests (including screenshots) for debugging purposes.
debug.warningBody: Debug mode stores full API requests including base64-encoded screenshots. This will significantly increase database size (5-20MB per request with 10 screenshots).
debug.warningEstimate: With {{requests}} requests per day, expect ~{{gb}} GB per day. Old debug logs are automatically deleted after the retention period.
debug.retentionDescription: Debug logs older than this will be automatically deleted daily to prevent database bloat.
debug.retentionValidation: Retention days must be between 1 and 30
debug.cleanupSuccess: Cleaned up {{count}} old debug log entries

developerTools.title: Developer tools
developerTools.description: These actions are intended for development and testing only.
developerTools.dayEnded: Today is currently ended. Click to reopen it.
